stories.title: Follow live: Gibbs' second TD extends Detroit lead in NFC North showdown
Steelers owner: Rodgers' 'insubordination can't be tolerated,' backs McCarthy
stories.summary: Steelers owner Art Rooney II reacted to Wednesday's fiery interview from Aaron Rodgers by saying he was "disappointed in where this went" with their now-former quarterback, adding he has "100% confidence in Mike McCarthy."

stories.title: Bears TE Loveland (knee) carted to locker room, won't return vs. Lions
stories.summary: The Bears have ruled out tight end Colston Loveland for the rest of Thursday's game at Detroit with a left knee injury.

stories.title: Thanksgiving delight for Pulisic as USMNT star nets vital Milan winner
stories.summary: Christian Pulisic enjoyed a Thanksgiving to remember as the United States star came off the bench to help spark AC Milan's comeback win at Olympiacos.

stories.title: Devils' Dillon receives 4-game suspension for illegal hit to the head
stories.summary: Devils defenseman Brenden Dillon was suspended Thursday for four games for an illegal hit to the head of Blue Jackets defenseman Denton Mateychuk.
